explication: Nacos is a platform for service discovery and health checks, dynamic configuration, DNS-based routing, and service metadata management. A typical workflow starts with a service or operator making a request, which Nacos handles through its relevant API and domain subsystem and returns discovery, configuration, or management results. The tree also shows substantial AI-resource management and publishing capabilities. The README documents the platform-level capabilities; source-index references and excerpts support only a subset of internal links, so other links are omitted rather than inferred.
